body:
Close-all now passes each symbol's notional, which `calculateFees` needs after the 18.0.0 break included in this 19.0.0 bump: a bounded subscription waiver is withheld when `amount` is omitted, while submit still derives notional and applies the waiver.

These other previews still quote without `amount`, so the rate cannot change with size and can show the next-higher source (rewards, or the full builder fee) instead of the blended rate that will be charged:

- `ui/components/app/perps/order-entry/order-entry.tsx` (~121)
- `ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx` (~713), also used for `closeEstimatedFees`
- `ui/components/app/perps/close-position/close-position-modal.tsx` (~520)
- `ui/components/app/perps/reverse-position/reverse-position-modal.tsx` (~123)
- `ui/components/app/perps/order-entry/components/auto-close-section/auto-close-section.tsx` (~96)
- `ui/components/app/perps/update-tpsl/update-tpsl-modal-content.tsx` (~131)

Pass the current USD notional through `usePerpsOrderFees` and refetch when it changes.
action: Already addressed in the current branch: every preview supplies notional; resolved discounts use controller quote metadata. Existing replies retained. This run preserves that fix and applies the lead extraction separately.

body:
Resolved quotes are no longer multiplied by the rewards bips, but `metamaskFeeRateDiscountPercentage` (just below) is still those bips (`rewardsBips / 100`) and `originalMetamaskFeeRate` is `Math.max(quotedRate, 0.001)` whenever the quote is chargeable.

`PerpsFeesDisplay` shows the VIP badge from that percentage and the strikethrough from this reconstructed rate, so a subscription waiver — or a rewards lookup that disagrees with `calculateFees` — advertises a different discount than the dollar fee.

For non-fallback quotes, derive the badge and the pre-discount rate from the resolved quote, and show the badge only when that quote is actually reduced. Keep the rewards factor on local fallbacks only.
